            "full_formula": lines[0].split()[1].strip("()") +" "+ lines[0].split()[2].strip("()") +" " + lines[0].split()[3].strip("()"),

            "sites": []
        }

        print(f"Error parsing the initial part of the structure: {lines}")

import random

# Target total samples and per-bin quota
total_samples = 8000
num_bins = 47
initial_bin_quota = total_samples // num_bins  # 500 samples per bin

# Initialize the final sampled indices list
sampled_indices = []

# Step 1: Sample from each bin up to the bin quota or the total available in the bin
remaining_quota = total_samples
for bin_name, indices in bin_indices.items():
    # Sample up to initial_bin_quota or the total available indices in the bin
    bin_sample = indices if len(indices) <= initial_bin_quota else random.sample(indices, initial_bin_quota)
